nodes.label: InLab Map v1.0 — Hospital Central de la Defensa Gomez Ulla
nodes.rationale: A hospital-specific interactive facility/floor map deliverable (area-card/planta-card grid, print-optimized @media print rules, color-coded legend for external/lab/plataforma/urgencias areas) generated for a named client site (Hospital Central de la Defensa Gomez Ulla), reusing the InLab teal/orange brand tokens but as a standalone printable HTML artifact outside the Next.js app.
